title: Cute......But.....
text: Cute......But...... This item is cute, however it is SO SMALL.  The price point is way too high for this teenie piece of wood.  I honestly thought that it was going to be bigger and look cute as a Christmas decoration in my home, but it looks more like a dollhouse decoration.  The consumer should get 3 of these for the price of 1.  Very disappointed in this purchase, and will be returning.
